title: About the Entra ID Change Detection Object Safelist

blocks.text: After you connect an Entra ID tenant to the Zscaler ITDR Admin Portal, ITDR continuously monitors the Entra ID tenant for any malicious changes that could potentially introduce a new identity and privilege escalation risk. These changes are available to view on the Entra ID Change Detection dashboard. You can review these changes to confirm that they are not a risk and mark them as safe by moving them to the object safelist if the changes are associated with a principal_id.
The Entra ID Change Detection Object Safelist provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View the list of Entra ID objects that don't pose a risk and are marked safe.
Ensure that the risk score on the Entra ID dashboard reflects the actual risk.

blocks.heading: About the Entra ID Change Detection Object Safelist Page

blocks.text: On the Entra ID Change Detection Object Safelist page (ITDR > Settings > Entra ID Change Detection Object Safelist), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Select an Entra ID tenant from the Result for drop-down menu.
View the list of objects that are marked safe. For each object, you can view:
Name: The name of the user associated with the issue.
Associated Issue: The issue associated with the object.
Created On: The date when the change detection was added to the safelist.
Created By: The name of the user who added the change detection to the safelist.
Reason: The reason why the change detection was added to the safelist.
Expiry: The date when the object is deleted from the safelist.
Edit or delete an object from the safelist.
